packages.name: @kiln/kiln
packages.purpose: The Kiln compiler: a generic IR/rewrite/fork-decision core (src/core) and a GPU compiler stack on it (src/std): nn/tensor dialects, loop fusion, tile scheduling with a cost model, kernel materialisation, CUDA/WGSL/simulator emitters, devices, measurement records, evidence store, tuner and kiln-program/1 export.
packages.notes: Plain ES modules, no build, no types. Deps: acorn 8.19.0, @kiln/evidence (TS source). Tests: 13 node scripts run by scripts/run-node-tests.mjs.

packages.name: runtime/webgpu
packages.purpose: Browser launcher for kiln-program/1: KilnWebGpuProgram.create(device, program), write, encode, run, destroy.
packages.notes: Imports nothing from the repo. Only consumer: runtime/test/webgpu-roundtrip.mjs (headless Chrome).

packages.name: runtime/python
packages.purpose: Python launcher for kiln-program/1 with two backends: wgpu-py (WgpuProgram) and CUDA via ctypes driver API + NVRTC (CudaProgram, allocate=False for caller-owned memory). CLI: kiln_launch.py check <fixtures> --backend.
packages.notes: numpy required; wgpu or libcuda/libnvrtc (system or torch wheel). runtime/test/fixtures.mjs is counted here: it builds the fixture programs both launchers and the kiln-perf image check.

packages.name: runner
packages.purpose: CUDA execution on a GPU host: kiln_runner.py (nvcc harness, kiln-bundle/1 -> kiln-results/1, runs inside the kiln-perf image) and kiln_driver.py (kiln-driver/1 HTTP executor: blobs, jobs as Docker containers, per-GPU flock, events, archives, self-replace).
packages.notes: Standard library only (+ nvcc, docker, nvidia-smi on the host). No test file in the repo is named for either.

packages.name: runner/docker
packages.purpose: The kiln-perf image (Ubuntu 24.04, CUDA 13.0 nvcc + NVRTC, numpy, optional Nsight Compute) with the runner, the Python launcher, prebuilt fixtures, kiln-probe and kiln-selftest; plus the perf-lab-cpu image.
packages.notes: build.sh refuses a dirty tree over runner, runtime/python, runtime/test, packages/kiln/src, apps/workbench/src and apps/workbench/presets, because fixtures are compiled from the workbench.

packages.name: imports/kiln-workbench-src
packages.purpose: The original Kiln Workbench as received: one app/ (core, std, ui, agent, tests), presets, runner, docs, built HTML and the zip it came in. Frozen; not imported by live code.
packages.notes: 116 tracked files under imports/ including kiln-workbench-src.zip (1.09 MB). 11948 lines excluding dist, built HTML and package-lock; app/src alone 8187 lines.

modules.name: compiler core
modules.purpose: Generic graph IR, dialects, patterns, rules, passes, forks, decision policies, pipelines, run engine; index algebra; utilities; script runner.
modules.notes: Directory row. Depends on nothing but acorn, except core/script.js -> std/index.js.

modules.name: kiln.js (IR, rewriting, forks, Run)
modules.purpose: Types, KilnError/Skip, global build scopes and dialect registry, OpDef/Dialect, Node/Graph (clone, topo, dce, print, eval), Value proxies, Builder/graph/trace/lift, patterns P, params/knobs, Fork/fork/expandFork, decide policies, Rule/Pass/Pipeline/Strategy, the Run engine, identityOf, unifiedDiff, the k namespace.
modules.key_exports: k; tensor; scalar; T; KilnError; Skip; skip; OpDef; Dialect; DIALECTS; dialect; Node; Graph; Value; wrap; Builder; graph; trace; lift; Pat; P; Param; param; ParamSet; params; knobs; Fork; fork; decide; Rule; rule; Pass; pass; PipelineBuilder; pipeline; Pipeline; Strategy; strategy; Run; identityOf; unifiedDiff
modules.notes: 70.7 KB. Module-level state: SCOPES :20, METHODS :25, DIALECTS :99, GID :112, RID :621.

modules.name: ix.js (index expressions)
modules.purpose: Immutable, self-simplifying integer index expressions with a linear normal form; index maps; emit to js/c/wgsl.
modules.key_exports: Ix; C; V; lift; ix; keyOf; vars; subst; evalIx; affine; print; emit; toJs; IxMap; coordVars; map; compose; identity

modules.name: util.js
modules.purpose: cyrb53 hash, mulberry32 rng with normal(), formatting, numel/strides/inKey/dtypeBytes, host Tensor, compare, median.
modules.key_exports: hash; rng; inKey; dtypeBytes; strides; numel; Tensor; compare; median; fmtUs; fmtNum; fmtBytes; fmtMs; clip; summarize; dur

modules.name: script.js (preset script runner)
modules.purpose: Parses a user/preset script with acorn and evaluates it with new Function over makeScriptScope().
modules.notes: Below 50 LOC; listed because it is the only core -> std import (script.js:4).

modules.name: GPU compiler stack (std)
modules.purpose: Dialects nn/tensor/loop/tile/kernel/gpu, their passes, emitters, simulator, cost model, devices, records, evidence store, tuner, export, hypotheses.

modules.name: std/index.js (std namespace, Project)
modules.purpose: The std namespace object, the Project class preset scripts build, and the script scope.

modules.name: emmy.js (default pipeline)
modules.purpose: The default pipeline 'emmy' (d,o,l,f,s,t,k,c over IRs torch..gpu) and its decision chain pinned -> evidence -> cost model -> first.

modules.name: targets.js (GPU specs)
modules.purpose: SPECS for rtx5090, rtx4090, h100, a100, gb10 (measured with kiln-probe 2026-10-20), orin; WEBGPU_DEFAULT; target().
modules.notes: Below 50 LOC; single source of device specs for the compiler.

modules.name: fns.js (scalar function table)
modules.purpose: Per scalar function: JS, C and WGSL templates and a flop count; reducers with identities.
modules.key_exports: FNS; REDUCERS; fn; reducer; fill; fr

modules.name: tensor IR stage (nn, tensor dialects)
modules.purpose: Frontend dialects nn (torch-like) and tensor (ew/reduce/view/const), reference evaluators, decompositions (pass d) and frontend optimisation (pass o).
modules.key_exports: nn; tensor; N; T; weight; decompose; decompositions; decomposition pass; optimization pass; ewRef; reduceRef; viewRef; matmulRef
modules.notes: Module-level VIEW_FNS cache of new Function view evaluators (tensor.js:83-101).

modules.name: loop IR stage
modules.purpose: Hash-consed scalar expressions, loop nests with LICM scheduling, JS reference compiler, loop.kernel dialect, lift (l), fusion merge_loop_ops (f), stamp names (s).
modules.key_exports: E; substE; walkE; printE; schedule; printNest; workOf; compileSerial; compilePoint; runSerial; loop dialect; liftPass; fusionPass; stampPass
modules.notes: Module-level INTERN (capped 400000), FREE WeakMap, RV counter. loop.kernel identity omits dtype (loop.js:277).

modules.name: tile IR stage (schedules, cost model)
modules.purpose: Schedule knobs MAP/TPB/COARSEN/STAGE/BM/BN/BK/TM/TN, kernel analysis, legal maps, the schedule fork tree, launch geometry, register estimate, roofline+occupancy time model, analytic counts, tile.kernel dialect, pass t.
modules.key_exports: KNOBS; canonRow; analyze; legalMaps; forkTree; launch; regsEstimate; timeModel; estimate; printTile; scheduleRule; costPrior; tilePass

modules.name: kernel IR stage
modules.purpose: Kernel IR statements (let/iset/load/store/sload/sstore/sync/for/if/note), builder KB, materialisation (thread/row tree-combine/tiled), redundant-sync removal, kernel.kernel dialect, pass k.
modules.key_exports: kx; KB; matThread; matRow; matTiled; materialize; printKernelBody; materializeRule; dropRedundantSyncs; kernelPass

modules.name: program.js (gpu dialect, programOf, inputs, simulation)
modules.purpose: gpu.kernel dialect and emit pass c; programOf(g) -> {kernels, graph}; seeded inputs; reference sampling; SIMT simulation with metrics.
modules.key_exports: programOf; seedOf; kernelInputs; referenceAt; sampleIndices; sampleBlocks; simulateKernel; regsOf; metricsOf; simulateFull; emitPass
modules.notes: Module-level SIMS WeakMap. Identity recomputed at program.js:19 and :38.

modules.name: emit.js (CUDA, WGSL, simulator emitters)
modules.purpose: toCuda, toWgsl (65535 grid fold, packed u8), toSim (lockstep SIMT simulator generated as JS, instrumented metrics).

modules.name: devices.js (SimDevice, WebGpuDevice, protocol)

formats.name: kiln-program/1

fields.name: buffers
fields.type: [{id, dtype, elements, bytes, name?, data? (base64 constant)}]

fields.name: kernels
fields.type: [{name, identity, row, reads, writes, grid, block, smemBytes, dispatch, shape, inShapes, inDtypes, wgsl, cuda}]

formats.notes: Kernel CUDA entry renamed to <cname>__<identity> (export.js:17,63). Launchers: runtime/README.md.

formats.name: kiln-program-set/1
formats.notes: Only the writer exists in tracked sources.

formats.name: kiln-measure/1

fields.name: kernel
fields.type: {name, identity, row, knobs, contentId, lang, sourceSha256, launch{grid, block, smem}}

fields.name: timing
fields.type: {kind, unit: us, samples[], launches?, warmup?, raw?}

formats.notes: contentId = sha256 of the source with the entry symbol canonicalised (records.js:39-51).

formats.name: kiln-evidence/2
formats.fields: Store snapshot of kiln-measure/1 records with derived status.

formats.name: kiln-evidence/1
formats.fields: Legacy rows {name, identity, row, knobs, metrics{blocks, threads, smem}, ...}
formats.notes: Kept only so files from the original can still be imported.

formats.name: kiln-bundle/1

fields.name: kernels
fields.type: [{name, identity?, source, inputs[{size, seed, dtype f32|u8}], samples[], out, grid, block}]

formats.notes: The runner rejects any other format string; dtypes other than f32/u8 raise per kernel.

fields.name: kernels
fields.type: [{name, identity, us_median, us_min, us_all[], samples[], regs} | {name, identity, error}]

formats.name: kiln-driver/1
formats.notes: GET /v1/jobs/<id>/plan and GET /v1/blobs/<sha256> are served but not in the docstring.

formats.name: kiln-plan/1
formats.fields: Job plan: steps (id, environment image, argv, env, mounts with roles bundle/cache/tool, gpu, timeout, conditions), outputs.
formats.notes: Validated by Driver.submit/check_step/resolve_mount; limits MAX_PLAN_BYTES 16 MiB, MAX_STEPS 4096.

formats.name: kiln-probe-request/1
formats.fields: Which environments (images) to probe for tool versions.

formats.name: kiln-facts/1
formats.fields: Host facts: cpu, memory, gpus (nvidia-smi), docker version, per-environment tool versions.

formats.name: kiln-execution/1
formats.fields: Per-job execution record written into the job directory and result.tar.gz.

formats.name: kiln-codegen/2
formats.fields: Version tag of the code generators; records from another codegen are stale.

formats.name: kiln IR checkpoints (torch, tensor, loop, tile, kernel, gpu)
formats.fields: Graph of frozen Nodes per IR; each IR declares its allowed dialects and is strict-checked.
